description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The application ID. Create and query it using the console. Only a single ID is supported.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

This API supports up to 10 queries per second (QPS) per user. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business operations. Use the API judiciously.
